capabilities: Build a homepage of note cards from section sources like properties, tags and folders
Filter and rank cards with conditions such as due dates or ratings
Run a project board by dragging cards between sections and setting note properties
Show any Bases group as a card section and give folders, tags or properties their own pages
Navigate cards by keyboard and pin, snooze or pass over notes without touching the notes
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; works on desktop and mobile. Stores session history in local storage outside synced settings. Integrations with Relate, Pagewise and Typify are optional and the plugin works fully without them. README includes privacy details, manual install steps, build instructions and a documented style-token list for theme authors.
intentEvidence: Bases gains a Home cards view, with one section per group.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page or dashboard that surfaces recent, due, related and forgotten notes on one screen.

relations.evidence: Relate, my plugin for two-way links between notes, adds sections for Relate searches
Pagewise, my plugin that shows notes as pages, gains an "Open Home Cards page" button
set Cards → Glyph to "Icon from Typify" and each card shows the icon

summary: Dashboard plugin that gives the vault a start page of note cards built from properties, tags, links and Bases, with pins, project boards and per-folder pages.
